description: Get computed CSS values for the given properties on the element matched by selector.

properties.description: CSS property names to return (kebab-case or camelCase)

selector.description: CSS selector for the target element

name: get_computed_style

styles.description: Map of property name → computed value. Keys match the input `properties` verbatim (case preserved). Values are `getComputedStyle` output; unknown properties yield empty string.
